package.description: 独立的 Windows 桌面宠物，通过本机 HTTP bridge 展示 Pi 的运行状态。

en-US.description: A standalone Windows desktop pet that visualizes the runtime status of Pi through a secure loopback HTTP bridge.
en-US.longDescription: Pi DeepSeek Pet is a standalone Windows desktop pet that visualizes the runtime status of Pi through a secure loopback HTTP bridge. It renders 97 640×360 VP9-alpha WebM animations in a transparent, frameless, always-on-top window, with idle random chains, turning, roaming, click feedback, dragging, and speech bubbles. Pi states such as thinking, responding, tool, waiting, and compacting are mapped to matching animations. The app works offline on its own and does not require Pi to be running first.

zh-CN.description: 独立的 Windows 桌面宠物，通过本机 HTTP bridge 展示 Pi 的运行状态。
zh-CN.longDescription: Pi DeepSeek Pet 是一个独立的 Windows 桌面宠物，通过仅监听 127.0.0.1 的本机 HTTP bridge 展示 Pi 的运行状态。它以透明、无边框、置顶的窗口呈现 97 个 640×360 VP9 Alpha WebM 动画，支持待机随机链、转向、漫游、点击反馈、拖拽和气泡，并将 Pi 的 thinking、responding、tool、waiting、compacting 等状态映射为相应的动画。应用可独立离线使用，不需要先启动 Pi。
zh-CN.name: Pi DeepSeek Pet
